form: HUD-52530B PBV HAP Contract for Existing Housing, Part 1 (04/2023), with the PHA's Exhibit A
notes: Form of contract approved by the board; effective date blank. The owner's name is spelled three ways in the packet: 'Mercy Housing Living Centers' (contract p.1), 'Mercy House Living Centers' (execution page, typed) and 'Mercy Housing Leasing Centers' (staff report); the cover letter says 'Mercy House'. The PDF keeps three fillable-field values that are not in its printed text: owner name, '20 years' and '7' (meaning of '7' unclear). PBV contracts are not in HUD's multifamily Section 8 database, and the project is not in the LIHTC database.
